prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1358; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Conroe. Before we begin, do you consent to this call being recorded?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.

A: I'd rather just keep to the accident itself, if that's okay. I can give you the mailing details in writing later.

Q: That works. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe. I had just pulled into a space near the front entrance and was backing out to leave.

Q: What was your speed as you backed up?

A: Very slow, maybe walking pace. I had my head turned over my right shoulder and was checking my mirrors.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: No. It came from my left side, between two rows of parked cars. I didn't see it until the impact.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?

A: The rear corner of my car hit the front passenger side of the other vehicle.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my neck got stiff and my lower back started aching. Now I have a lot of soreness when I turn my head and when I sit for long periods.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since then?

A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic and was told I have a neck and back strain. I was given medication and a referral to follow up with my own doctor.

Q: Had you experienced any neck or back problems before this incident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I had no treatment for either area.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want my vehicle inspected as soon as possible, since I still need to get to work.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with next steps shortly.
